items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Burbank WRP consists of bar screen removal of large solids, flow equalization, primary sedimentation, nitrification and denitrification (NDN) activated sludge biological treatment, secondary clarification, coagulation, single media and deep bed sand filtration, disinfection by chlorination with the addition of ammonium hydroxide, and dechlorination.
